title: A bit to lightweight for me.
text: A bit to lightweight for me.. Lightweight and wobbly. The top screw to secure the unit isn’t very long so it always feels like it will pop off. The entire thing does rotate easily. The brushed metal finish is nice too. I wouldn’t trust very heavy utensils in this or too many.
